DOWNFALL-HERMIT_STRIKE.title: Strike
DOWNFALL-HERMIT_DEFEND.title: Defend
DOWNFALL-SNAPSHOT.title: Snapshot
DOWNFALL-SNAPSHOT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to unblocked damage dealt.
DOWNFALL-COVET.title: Covet
DOWNFALL-MEMENTO_CARD.title: Memento
DOWNFALL-BODY_ARMOR.title: Body Armor
DOWNFALL-BODY_ARMOR.description:
Discard 1 card.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If it was a non-Attack, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] again.
DOWNFALL-CALLED_SHOT.title: Called Shot
DOWNFALL-CALLED_SHOT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the last card played this turn triggered [gold]Dead On[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
DOWNFALL-COALESCENCE.title: Coalescence
DOWNFALL-COALESCENCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Retain[/gold] up to {CoalescencePower:diff()} cards this turn.
DOWNFALL-DIVE.title: Dive
DOWNFALL-FEINT.title: Feint
DOWNFALL-GLARE.title: Glare
DOWNFALL-HEADSHOT.title: Headshot
DOWNFALL-HEADSHOT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Deal double damage.
DOWNFALL-HIGH_CALIBER.title: High-Caliber
DOWNFALL-HIGH_CALIBER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Strike+[/gold] that deals {StrikeDamage:diff()} damage into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-HOLE_UP.title: Hole Up
DOWNFALL-ITCHY_TRIGGER.title: Itchy Trigger
DOWNFALL-ITCHY_TRIGGER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Reduce the cost of a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] by {CostReduction:diff()} this turn.
DOWNFALL-LOW_PROFILE.title: Low Profile
DOWNFALL-MANIFEST.title: Manifest
DOWNFALL-MISFIRE.title: Misfire
DOWNFALL-MISFIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Clumsy[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DOWNFALL-PISTOL_WHIP.title: Pistol Whip
DOWNFALL-QUICKDRAW.title: Quickdraw
DOWNFALL-QUICKDRAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Next turn, draw 1 less card.
DOWNFALL-ROULETTE.title: Roulette
DOWNFALL-ROULETTE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Draw that many cards.
DOWNFALL-SPRAY_PRAY.title: Spray n' Pray
DOWNFALL-SPRAY_PRAY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
Shuffle a [gold]Doubt[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DOWNFALL-TRACKING_SHOT.title: Tracking Shots
DOWNFALL-VANTAGE.title: Vantage
DOWNFALL-WIDE_OPEN.title: Wide Open
DOWNFALL-BIG_SHOT.title: Smoking Barrel
DOWNFALL-BIG_SHOT.description: Whenever you trigger a [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect, gain {BigShotPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BRAWL.title: Brawl
DOWNFALL-BRAWL.description: At the start of your turn, apply {BrawlPower:diff()} [gold]Bruise[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DOWNFALL-CHEAT.title: Cheat
DOWNFALL-CHEAT.description:
Play 1 of the top {Cards:diff()} cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Also trigger its [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect.
DOWNFALL-COMBO.title: Combo
DOWNFALL-COMBO.description: The first {ComboPower:diff()} [gold]Dead On[/gold] {ComboPower:plural:card|cards} you trigger each turn {ComboPower:plural:returns|return} to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CURSED_WEAPON.title: Cursed Weapon
DOWNFALL-CURSED_WEAPON.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Cursed Weapons[/gold] permanently deal {DamageIncrease:diff()} more damage.
DOWNFALL-DEAD_MANS_HAND.title: Dead Man's Hand
DOWNFALL-DEAD_MANS_HAND.description:
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Put the {Cards:diff()} rarest cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-DEADEYE.title: Deadeye
DOWNFALL-DESPERADO.title: Desperado
DOWNFALL-DESPERADO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Double this card's damage this combat. It costs 1 more.
DOWNFALL-DETERMINATION.title: Determination
DOWNFALL-DETERMINATION.description: Whenever a Debuff is applied to you, gain {DeterminationPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-ENERVATE.title: Enervate
DOWNFALL-ENERVATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
DOWNFALL-EYE_OF_THE_STORM.title: Eye of the Storm
DOWNFALL-EYE_OF_THE_STORM.description:
[gold]Concentrate[/gold].
Gain Energy up to your maximum.
DOWNFALL-FLASH_POWDER.title: Flash Powder
DOWNFALL-FULLY_LOADED.title: Fully Loaded
DOWNFALL-FULLY_LOADED.description: Put ALL [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-GESTALT.title: Gestalt
DOWNFALL-GHOSTLY_PRESENCE.title: Ghostly Presence
DOWNFALL-GHOSTLY_PRESENCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DOWNFALL-GOLDEN_BULLET.title: Golden Bullet
DOWNFALL-GOLDEN_BULLET.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], permanently reduce this card's cost by 1.
DOWNFALL-GRUDGE.title: Grudge
DOWNFALL-HORROR.title: Horror
DOWNFALL-HORROR.description:
Apply {BruisePower:diff()} [gold]Bruise[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Bruise[/gold] does not wear off this turn.
DOWNFALL-IMPENDING_DOOM.title: Impending Doom
DOWNFALL-IMPENDING_DOOM.description: If this is [gold]Dead On[/gold] at the end of your turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to EVERYONE.
DOWNFALL-LONE_WOLF.title: Lone Wolf
DOWNFALL-LONE_WOLF.description:
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
It costs 0 this turn.
Discard the rest of your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-LONE_WOLF.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to keep and make cost 0 this turn.
DOWNFALL-LUCK_OF_THE_DRAW.title: Luck of the Draw
DOWNFALL-LUCK_OF_THE_DRAW.description: Draw cards until their total cost is {CostThreshold:diff()} or more.
DOWNFALL-MAINTENANCE.title: Maintenance
DOWNFALL-MAINTENANCE.description:
[gold]Strikes[/gold] deal {MaintenanceStrikePower:diff()} more damage this combat.
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
This costs 1 more this combat.
DOWNFALL-MALICE.title: Malice
DOWNFALL-MALICE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Curse[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies instead.
DOWNFALL-MIDNIGHT.title: Midnight
DOWNFALL-MIDNIGHT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add an [gold]Impending Doom[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-NO_HOLDS_BARRED.title: No Holds Barred
DOWNFALL-NO_HOLDS_BARRED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {BruisePower:diff()} [gold]Bruise[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} less next turn.
DOWNFALL-RICOCHET.title: Ricochet
DOWNFALL-RICOCHET.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Repeat on a random enemy for each [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect this turn.
DOWNFALL-SCAVENGE.title: Scavenge
DOWNFALL-SHADOW_CLOAK.title: Shadow Cloak
DOWNFALL-SHADOW_CLOAK.description: Whenever you draw or [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Curse[/gold] card, gain {ShadowCloakPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SHORTFUSE.title: Short Fuse
DOWNFALL-SHORTFUSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less per [gold]Strike[/gold] or [gold]Defend[/gold] played this turn.
DOWNFALL-SHOWDOWN.title: Showdown
DOWNFALL-SHOWDOWN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Play all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SNIPE.title: Snipe
DOWNFALL-SNIPE.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Concentrate[/gold].
|}Your next [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect this turn triggers twice.
DOWNFALL-SPITE.title: Spite
DOWNFALL-SPITE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Unplayable[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
DOWNFALL-TAKE_AIM.title: Take Aim
DOWNFALL-TAKE_COVER.title: Take Cover
DOWNFALL-TAKE_COVER.description: Add a 0-cost [gold]Defend{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it X times.
DOWNFALL-VIRTUE.title: Virtue
DOWNFALL-VIRTUE.description: Reduce each of your Debuffs by {ReduceAmount:diff()}.
DOWNFALL-ADAPT.title: Adapt
DOWNFALL-ADAPT.description: At the start of your turn, you may [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card to gain 8 [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BLACK_WIND.title: Black Wind
DOWNFALL-BLACK_WIND.description:
Deal damage equal to your missing HP.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)|}
DOWNFALL-DEAD_OR_ALIVE.title: Dead Or Alive
DOWNFALL-DEAD_OR_ALIVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], gain 15 / 40 / 100 Gold (Normal / Elite / Boss).
DOWNFALL-DISSOLVE.title: Dissolve
DOWNFALL-ETERNAL_FORM.title: Eternal Form
DOWNFALL-ETERNAL_FORM.description: The first 4 playable cards drawn at the start of each turn cost 1 less that turn.
DOWNFALL-FATAL_DESIRE.title: Fatal Desire
DOWNFALL-FATAL_DESIRE.description: At the start of your turn, draw 2 cards and add an [gold]Injury[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-FINAL_CANTER.title: Final Canter
DOWNFALL-FINAL_CANTER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Curse[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-FROM_BEYOND.title: From Beyond
DOWNFALL-FROM_BEYOND.description: For each card in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], a random enemy loses {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
DOWNFALL-GAMBIT.title: Gambit
DOWNFALL-GAMBIT.description: Put {Cards:diff()} random Attacks from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They cost 1 less this turn.
DOWNFALL-HEROIC_BRAVADO.title: Heroic Bravado
DOWNFALL-HEROIC_BRAVADO.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Rugged[/gold].
Increase the cost of this card by {CostIncrease:diff()} this combat.
DOWNFALL-HIGH_NOON.title: High Noon
DOWNFALL-HIGH_NOON.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Strike[/gold] or [gold]Defend[/gold], draw a card.
DOWNFALL-MAGNUM.title: Magnum
DOWNFALL-MAGNUM.description:
Discard 6 cards.
For each card discarded, deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
DOWNFALL-OVERWHELMING_POWER.title: Overwhelming Power
DOWNFALL-OVERWHELMING_POWER.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Whenever you end your turn with 0 [gold]Energy[/gold], lose {OverwhelmingPowerPower:diff()} HP.
DOWNFALL-PURGATORY.title: Purgatory
DOWNFALL-REPRIEVE.title: Reprieve
DOWNFALL-ROUGHHOUSE.title: Roughhouse
DOWNFALL-ROUNDHOUSE_KICK.title: Roundhouse Kick
DOWNFALL-ROUNDHOUSE_KICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Stun[/gold] any that do not intend to attack.
